release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.5.2 — Zero-Contamination Question Bank, Purged Legacy Files & Parent Reporting Suite:
• 100% NCERT Rationalized Question Bank: Strictly 30,000 deduplicated, authentic curriculum questions (Classes 6-12) with zero legacy remnants, zero placeholder slop, and zero arithmetic trivia.
• Absolute Class Question Isolation: Hardcoded question queries strictly bound to student's exact class with zero cross-class fallbacks.
• Complete Legacy Purge: All legacy question JSON files permanently removed from codebase and asset bundles.
• Parent Study & Wellbeing Reporting Suite: Interactive period filters (Today, 7 Days, 7 Weeks), real-time digital wellbeing analytics, AI cognitive behavioral diagnoses, and one-tap dossier export via WhatsApp/Email.
• Skeuomorphic Obsidian Safe Vault Keypad: 3D physical tactile keycaps with glowing cyan capsule LEDs and biometric override.
